name: TestcaseClassPerFixture
summary: Puts into one testcase class exactly the tests that need the same starting state, so that the setup is written once and is true for every test in it.

roles.name: TestcaseClassPerFixture
roles.summary: The organisation that follows the fixture. Every test in the class shares one starting state, which is what lets the setup be read once rather than re-read per test — and what makes a test that needs something slightly different a signal to split the class rather than to widen the setup.
